text:
Sorry about that, but it's fixable. Lost gift card codes are reissued if the person who purchased the card gives us the **gift card order number**. Please send that order number (it starts with `LF-` followed by six digits) and we'll take it from there. Please don't share any full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.

If you were the recipient rather than the purchaser, the purchaser will need to contact us with their order number. I can also escalate this if you can't get hold of it.
